    Coefficients of polynomial lifts at a rigid point of a pencil #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_affine_polynomial_solution {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k V] [Module k W] [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Finite k W] (A B : V →ₗ[k] W) (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(A + B)) (v : V) (hv : (A + B) v = 0) :
    ∃ (z : PolynomialModule k V), (PolynomialModule.eval 1) z = v ∧ (PolynomialModule.map k A) z + Polynomial.X • (PolynomialModule.map k B) z = 0

    A null vector at the parameter one lifts to a polynomial solution over the ground field, expressed in the parameter vanishing at the special fiber.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_finite_pencil_coefficients {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k V] [Module k W] [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Finite k W] (A B : V →ₗ[k] W) (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(A + B)) (v : V) (hv : (A + B) v = 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → V), (∀ (i : ℕ), n ≤ i → a i = 0) ∧ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i = v ∧ A (a 0) = 0 ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), A (a (i + 1)) + B (a i) = 0

    A polynomial lift gives a finite sequence satisfying the pencil recurrence. Its sum recovers the prescribed vector at the rigid point.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_stable_pencil_coefficients {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k V] [Module k W] [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Finite k W] (A B : V →ₗ[k] W) (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(A + B)) (v : V) (hv : (A + B) v = 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → V), (∀ (i : ℕ), n ≤ i → a i = v) ∧ A (a 0) = 0 ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), A (a (i + 1)) + B (a i) = 0

    Partial sums of a finite polynomial lift satisfy the same recurrence and stabilize at the prescribed vector.
